connectors.name: Blender 3D Bridge
connectors.description: Local TCP JSON-RPC 2.0 bridge for Blender scene inspection, guarded bpy script execution, and inline viewport PNG preview rendering.

tools.name: blender_get_scene_info
tools.description: Inspect active Blender objects, cameras, lights, materials, and render settings.

tools.name: blender_execute_script
tools.description: Execute a generated Python (bpy) script inside the connected Blender instance.

tools.name: blender_render_preview
tools.description: Render the active camera or viewport and return an inline PNG buffer.

connectors.name: Google Workspace
connectors.description: Client-side Gmail and Google Calendar integration via OAuth 2.0 PKCE loopback auth and battery-aware incremental delta polling.

tools.name: gmail_list_messages
tools.description: Query primary unread or prioritized Gmail messages for triage and morning briefings.

tools.name: gmail_send_message
tools.description: Send an email reply or new message through Gmail after explicit user approval.

tools.name: gcal_list_events
tools.description: Fetch upcoming Google Calendar meetings and detect scheduling conflicts.

tools.name: gcal_create_event
tools.description: Create or modify a Google Calendar event after explicit user approval.
